The first release of **Vem sa vad?** — private audio and video transcription that runs in your browser
and tells you who said what. Nothing is uploaded and nothing needs to be installed.

**Use it now:** [vemsavad.promptagency.se](https://vemsavad.promptagency.se) (Chrome or Edge).

### What's in 1.0
- Files, microphone recordings and podcast episodes in one queue, with a live preview while transcribing.
- KB-Whisper from the National Library of Sweden for Swedish, plus multilingual and English Whisper
  models, on the graphics card (WebGPU) or the processor.
- Speaker separation for up to three voices (95.6% of words to the right speaker on a two-person
  interview), with names you choose.
- A review view: play any line, see unsure lines, fix text and speakers, find & replace.
- A word list that suggests corrections for names and terms that come out wrong.
- Readable `.txt`/`.md` documents, `.srt`/`.vtt` subtitles and `.json`.
- A Swedish interface with English as an option, an FAQ, and control over what's stored: transcripts only
  if you choose, and downloaded models can be removed.

### Hosting it yourself
`vem-sa-vad-v1.0.0.zip` below is the built site. Unzip it onto a web server over HTTPS: Apache with PHP
works out of the box, with `.htaccess` and the podcast proxy `proxy.php` included. Other servers need
their own HTTPS redirect, and podcasts need a PHP-capable proxy. See
[docs/hosting.md](https://github.com/promptagency/vem-sa-vad/blob/main/docs/hosting.md).

Built on [Bjarbys Transcriber](https://github.com/fltman/bjarbys-transcriber) by Anders Bjarby (MIT).
